brand_truth: A 100% Bahamian-owned Nassau security company since 2004 whose office closes at 5 while its central station watches all night.
buyer: Nassau homeowners, shop and office owners, property managers comparing security firms after a break-in or an insurance prompt.

direction.why: The product is time (office hours vs 24/7 monitoring, guards on post), so the page is one film from morning to 3 am; night is genuinely the business's hour, with the title card and planner on a light ground.

tier_visual_why: Photographic film with real-time crossfades; WebGL would not explain a service business better.

notes: Gen 2 rebuild by site worker. Track B (no site). BLIND sandbox: photos seen in the Lovable gallery (ip-assets-pro-tech-security, two rounds) and routed as crops into QA shots. Hero shows the street at the live Nassau time (day/dusk/night images of one scene, edited from the same frame) and a 24-hour scrubber. Plan gate asked for: larger photo and display-size status line, visible camera/keypad hardware (regenerated), chapters pinned full-bleed with captions at a fixed anchor, a CCTV close-up instead of repeating the street, dropping the lone text card; all applied. Captions sit on a solid night panel (not an image overlay) for legibility. Scores recorded are the plan-gate predictions after revision. No email published, so conversion is by phone plus a copyable request. Shared interact.mjs hung on this page (tall pinned stage; killed after 9 min); interactions verified with a custom Playwright script instead: hour stops and slider rewrite the status and crossfade frames, menu opens and closes on Escape, planner chips update the request, 0 JS errors. QA: 0 blockers; distinct OK (closest 70).
